data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman 2030 in Marbella is a monumental achievement. After months of training, 3.8 km of swimming, 180 km of cycling, and a full marathon, your body deserves more than a protein shake. A Marbella boat rental for Ironman 2030 recovery is the ultimate way to unwind — floating on the Mediterranean with cold drinks, gentle sea breezes, and zero effort. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, just a 5-minute taxi ride from the race finish on the Golden Mile. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, with everything included: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden fees, no stress — just pure recovery.

Why Choose a Boat Charter for Post-Ironman Recovery?

After Ironman, your muscles are depleted, your joints are inflamed, and your central nervous system is fried. Sitting on a sun lounger by a pool is fine, but a boat adds three recovery advantages: cold water immersion (the Med is around 22°C in June), passive stretching on a gently rocking deck, and mental reset away from crowds. Our Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749 for 2 hours) offer cushioned seating, shaded areas, and a cool breeze at 10–15 knots. No swimming required — just lie back and let the boat do the work.

Our Boats for Ironman 2030 Recovery Charters

We have a fleet of 17 boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. For small groups (5–6 athletes), the Mariah SX21 speedboat (€749/2h) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) are nimble and fun. For larger squads (up to 11 guests), the Azimut 39 or Astondoa 40 provide ample deck space. Want a jet ski included? The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719 for 4 hours) comes with a free jet ski — perfect for anyone who still has energy to burn.

What’s Included in Your Recovery Cruise?

Every charter includes a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). You don’t need to lift a finger — just step aboard, grab a cold drink, and let the skipper navigate. If you want to bring your own recovery snacks or extra drinks, you’re welcome to.

Best Routes for Post-Race Relaxation

From Puerto Banús, popular recovery routes include a gentle cruise along the Golden Mile towards Cala del Faro (a quiet cove with calm waters) or west towards Estepona (30 minutes at 12 knots). For a longer trip, head to Cala Cortés or Sotogrande — both offer shallow, clear water perfect for a gentle dip. Your skipper will adjust the speed and route to your comfort level. No bumpy rides, no tight schedules.

How to Book Your Ironman 2030 Recovery Charter

Booking is simple. Visit our Marbella boat rental hub to browse the fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp for real-time availability and personalised advice. We recommend booking at least a week in advance during Ironman week, as charters sell out quickly. Same-day bookings are possible if slots remain. Payment can be made by bank transfer or card — we’ll send you a confirmation with all details.
